summary: auth import gains a --curl mode that ingests a browser DevTools "Copy as cURL" command: the Cookie header becomes the session and the request URL pins the marketplace base_url.
reason: The fastest hands-on way for a user to hand the CLI a logged-in session is to right-click the order-history request in DevTools and Copy as cURL. Parsing that paste (tolerant of bash \ and Windows ^ line continuations, single/double and bash $'...' quoting, and -H cookie / -b forms) extracts both the cookies and, from the URL host, the correct storefront — removing the need for a cookie-extraction tool or manual base_url config.
validated_outcome: Pasting a real amazon.ca Copy-as-cURL imports the full cookie jar and sets base_url=https://www.amazon.ca; the imported session then drives a successful live orders fetch.
